label: Scroll Wall
description: An endless scrolling wall of clips: 1-4 rows of video/image tiles slide sideways forever (optionally alternating direction) and loop seamlessly at whole cycles. Every tile is a real DSL cell at full native resolution; the pan is per-tile overlay motion, not a camera crop. Empty clips render a demo wall of colored tiles.

clips.label: Clips
clips.description: Clips for the wall — pick a folder, one or more files, or drag-and-drop (video and image). The wall cycles through the list, so one clip fills every slot; drop a file on the first tile showing a clip to replace it, on any repeat to add another. Every clip gets a slot in every row, so the wall takes up to 24 ÷ rows clips: 12 at the default 2 rows, 6 at 4 rows. Empty renders a demo wall of colored tiles.

visibleCount.label: Visible tiles
visibleCount.description: How many tiles are visible across the canvas. Reduced automatically (bigger tiles) when the row count would push the wall past its 24-tile budget — 11 tiles fit at 2 rows, 5 at 4.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: Base travel direction (odd rows flip when alternating).

motion.alternateRowDirection.label: Alternate rows
motion.alternateRowDirection.description: Flip travel direction on odd rows.

motion.rowOffsetFrac.label: Row offset
motion.rowOffsetFrac.description: Per-row phase offset as a fraction of the tile pitch.

motion.speedMode.label: Speed mode
motion.speedMode.description: Cycles per render, or an explicit px/sec speed.

motion.cycles.label: Cycles
motion.cycles.description: Strip cycles over the render. Whole numbers loop seamlessly.

motion.pxPerSec.label: Speed (px/s)
motion.pxPerSec.description: Explicit scroll speed when Speed mode is "pxPerSec".

motion.snapVelocityToFrameGrid.label: Snap to frame grid
motion.snapVelocityToFrameGrid.description: Round speed to whole pixels per frame (steadier motion, loop no longer closes exactly).

tiles.gapPx.label: Gap (px)
tiles.gapPx.description: Gap between tiles (snapped down to the canvas lattice; minimum 1 — the wrap needs off-screen slack; thinned further on a canvas too narrow to hold it).

tiles.marginPx.label: Margin (px)
tiles.marginPx.description: Vertical-only outer margin (a scrolling layer would bleed past any horizontal margin). Thinned automatically on a canvas too short to hold it and the rows.

tiles.fit.label: Fit
tiles.fit.description: cover crops to fill; contain letterboxes the frame.

tiles.backgroundColor.label: Background
tiles.backgroundColor.description: Canvas color behind the tile gaps.

tiles.clipWindowMs.label: Clip window (ms)
tiles.clipWindowMs.description: How much of each clip loops. 0 = automatic from the RAM budget.

tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.description: Tile gap, margins, fill and loop window.

variation.staggerRepeats.label: Stagger repeats
variation.staggerRepeats.description: Start repeated clips at a seeded offset so they aren't frame-identical.

debugGeometry.label: Debug geometry
debugGeometry.description: Dev-only geometry contract: assert every tile footprint survived to the pixels and stamp the achieved precision floors. Deterministic default false.
